history.summary: 1485 sqft 99yr 4BR at Bishan Point (D20) at $2.78M / $1872 PSF, ~3% over the $1811 median, just 340m from Bright Hill MRT (TE7). Strong 7.71% URA resale CAGR over an adequate 35-txn series and a high Elo (1684) — a well-located, well-performing TEL-corridor family unit.
history.rating_rationale: 340m to a TEL station, a 7.71% resale CAGR over 35 txns (reasonably reliable), strong Elo (1684, 327-88 record), and the Bishan/Upper Thomson catchment with top schools nearby. Entry is only slightly above median and the $2.78M quantum, while above the deepest band, is supported by genuine 4BR family/own-stay demand in a prized district. The 2005 99yr lease (~78yr left) is the main caveat. Solid investment with a real transit catalyst.

history.summary: Re-eval under v3.4-v3.6 priors strips the 7.71% trailing CAGR (no forward power) and tests the one validated signal: cheap-vs-district-peers. It fails. The last same-size print (1,485 sqft, Aug 2024) was $2.18M / $1,467 psf; this asks $2.78M / $1,872 psf — ~27% above it and above the project all-time-high psf ($1,848, set by a smaller 1,184 sqft unit). Age-adjusted vs newer D20 4BR peers (Clover ~$2,085, Sky Habitat ~$2,102 asking, 2012/2015 builds), fair is ~$1,750-1,860 psf, so the entry is rich, not cheap. Bright Hill TEL (340m) is operational and already in the price. Gross yield ~2.6-2.8%. Score 430 (<450 threshold). At a negotiated ~$2.4M this becomes interesting; at $2.78M it is overpriced vs verified comps.
history.rating_rationale: Asking ~27% above the only same-size comp (Aug 2024 $1,467 psf) and above the project record psf set by a smaller unit; large units trade at a psf discount, so true premium vs cohort exceeds the headline ~3%-over-median. Validated forward signals (cheap-vs-peers, region) are neutral-to-negative here; TEL is priced in; $2.78M quantum + 78yr lease + ~2.7% yield thin the exit. Prior Buy rested on trailing CAGR, which carries ~0 forward power.
red_flags: Asking $1,872 psf vs last same-size print $1,467 psf (Aug 2024, 1,485 sqft, $2.18M) — ~27% premium
Above project all-time-high $1,848 psf, which a smaller 1,184 sqft unit set — size-cohort premium even larger
$2.78M quantum above the deepest D20 buyer band — slower exit
2005 build, ~78yr lease remaining — decay on the back end
catalysts: 340m to operational Bright Hill MRT (TE7) — real amenity, but priced in, not a future catalyst
Bishan/Upper Thomson school catchment sustains family owner-occupier demand
Material price negotiation (toward ~$2.4M) would restore the value case
history.source: re-eval under v3.4.1+ priors (2026-06-11 loop iter 12; supersedes 2026-06-08 pre-prior-fix Buy)
